name: Elec-Tron
old_description: Elec-Tron of Wichita, Kansas has been proudly manufacturing power termination and electrical connectors in the USA since 1946.  Founded as Zimco Metal Products in April 1946, the company operated primarily as a contract manufacturer, producing miscellaneous metal stampings and assemblies. In 1954, the company changed its focus to producing primarily electrical switches, terminal blocks, and terminal boards. As Elec-Tron’s reputation for quality and timely delivery grew, the company began serving most major appliance manufacturers in the U.S. and abroad.
about:
Elec-Tron operates from Wichita, Kansas. Founded in April 1946 as Zimco Metal Products, a contract manufacturer of metal stampings and assemblies, the company shifted its focus in 1954 to electrical switches, terminal blocks, and terminal boards. In May 2022 it was acquired by North Park Group, a Chicago-based private family investment group that acquires family-owned U.S. manufacturers.

The company produces power termination and electrical connectors, including terminal blocks, terminal boards, fuse panels, mechanical aluminum lug connectors, and a range of terminals (quick-connect, screw, bifurcated soldering, and quick-connect tabs). Manufacturing is performed in-house, encompassing molding, stamping, assembly, and terminal identification printing. Annual output exceeds 10 million units shipped to over 300 customers. All components carry UL and CSA recognition.

Elec-Tron serves aerospace, appliance, automotive, electrical distribution, HVAC, commercial food and kitchen equipment, vending machines, industrial equipment, military, electric vehicle, and commercial equipment markets. Specific applications include furnaces, air conditioners, ovens, ranges, refrigerators, recreational vehicles, farm equipment, marine systems, material handling equipment, automatic door and gate openers, and motor controls.

The company was founded to provide reliable electrical connections; its engineers focus on delivering the right connection for the available space at competitive prices. Vertical integration and a broad catalog of standardized and custom configurations allow rapid fulfillment of diverse requirements.
